## 5. Recommendations for Next Pass

1. **Add GA4 tracking ID (urgent)** — replace G-XXXXXXXXXX in index.html, new-launches.html, and any other affected pages. Without it there is no conversion data and no GSC connection for keyword visibility.

2. **Add the 10 missing insights articles to sitemap.xml** — published pages being left off the sitemap. Append entries with lastmod 2026-04-25 and priority 0.8. Fastest fix: update the sitemap generation script to glob /public/insights/*.html.

3. **Resolve the blog/* orphan problem** — 301-redirect /blog/* to matching /insights/* equivalents (e.g. /blog/hdb-upgrade-timeline -> /insights/hdb-mop-upgrade-timeline). Preserves any link equity and cleans crawl budget.

4. **Add FAQPage JSON-LD schema to faq.html** — FAQ-rich snippets dominate SERP real estate for Singapore property queries. The page already has the Q&A content; adding the schema is a 15-minute edit.

5. **Audit HDB-towns and district detail page meta descriptions for uniqueness** — these are the highest-volume long-tail SEO pages on the site. If _render_rich_districts.py uses a boilerplate description, add per-page dynamic fields for town name, median PSF, and recent resale volume. Fixes 50+ pages in one script update.
